newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares rise to record close again.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares rise to record close again.

text.p: Swedish shares closed at a record high on Tuesday on broad market gains, especially for the forestry sector.
The Stockholm general index rose 1.15 percent to 2,666.60 in turnover of 5.3 billion crowns.
Drug company Astra closed five crowns stronger at 360, lifting the drug sector index by 1.47 percent. Telecoms group Ericsson gained three crowns to 239.5.

Construction company NCC posted double 1996 profits and the share fell 1.5 crowns. Skanska lost two crowns to 340 after reporting its annual results. "It was fair considering recent rises," one broker said about Skanska.

Mining and rubber group Trelleborg jumped 4.5 crowns to 118.5 after it said its Trelleborg Industri unit has bought the North American company Yale-South Haven Inc that has an annual turnover of about one billion crowns.
"It is good that they're on the offensive and starting to show what they'll do with their money," one broker said.
Ferry operator Stena Line fell 2.2 crowns to 37.5 after it posted an expected 1996 loss of 448 million crowns compared with a profit of 201 million a year earlier.
The forestry sector index jumped 2.5 percent, helped by a Wall Street trend.
